title: Inside Rémy Martin’s 2026 Latin Grammys Debut & Its Collaboration With Kapo
summary: The cognac house is raising a glass to Latin music's biggest night, celebrating the artists and people behind the music through its My Celebración campaign.
contentText:

There’s plenty to celebrate at this year’s Latin Grammys, and Rémy Martin is getting in on the festivities with a little help from Colombian singer Kapo .

For the first time, the French cognac house has been named the official cognac of the 2026 Latin Grammy Awards , marking a new partnership with the Latin Recording Academy. To celebrate, Rémy Martin is teaming up with Kapo for its My Celebración campaign, which puts the spotlight on the people, experiences and personal milestones behind an artist’s success.

The collaboration comes as Kapo celebrates a major milestone of his own: his first Latin Grammy nomination for best urban performance for “ La Villa .”

Rémy Martin

As part of the campaign, the Colombian artist is collaborating with Rémy Martin on an exclusive content series exploring the family, friends and cultural influences that have shaped his career.

The celebrations kicked off earlier this week, with Rémy Martin serving its signature 1738 Accord Royal cocktails at events across Las Vegas. Billboard got a firsthand taste of the festivities at the Leading Ladies of Entertainment and Best New Artist Showcase events, where the cocktails were flowing. The drinks offered a taste of Rémy Martin’s 1738 Accord Royal , known for its notes of toasted oak, butterscotch and spice.

Served throughout the 2026 Latin Grammys celebrations, Rémy Martin 1738 Accord Royal is a rich, smooth cognac with notes of toasted oak, butterscotch and spice.

Next up is the Person of the Year Gala, followed by the official Latin Grammys after-party, with Rémy Martin serving as the presenting spirit sponsor.

The 27th annual Latin Grammy Awards take place Thursday, Nov. 12, at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas. The ceremony will air live on Univision.
